description.narrative:
Projektet ämnar att bidra till att förbättra efterlevnaden av arbetslagar genom att förse Arbetsinspektionen med utbildning, moderna verktyg och resurser som går i linje med Internationella arbetsnormer. Det involverar också arbetsmarknadens parter i att främja rättvisa anställningsvillkor och stärka arbetarskyddet.
I slutet av projektet kommer arbetsinspektionen ha förbättrad tillsynskapacitet, företag kommer visa större efterlevnad av arbetslagstiftningen, och arbetsmarknadens parter kommer aktivt påverka arbetsmarknadspolitiken. Ökad medvetenhet hos allmänheten och samarbete mellan institutioner kommer att stärka den långsiktiga utvecklingen av en säkrare och mer transparent arbetsmarknad i Kosovo.

The project improves compliance with labor laws by providing the Labour Inspectorate (LI) with enhanced training, modern tools, and resources aligned with International Labour Standards (ILS). It also involves social partners in promoting fair employment practices and strengthening worker protection.
By the end of the project, the LI will have enhanced enforcement capabilities, businesses will demonstrate greater compliance with labor laws and social partners will actively influence labor policy. Increased public awareness and collaboration among institutions will reinforce long-term enforcement, helping to create a safer and more transparent labor market in Kosovo.

The contribution aims to create a more equitable and efficient labor environment, promote and foster sustainable economic growth, and enhance the overall well-being of workers. Drawing on past successes, it has been carefully developed in collaboration with the Labour Inspectorate and in consultation with key stakeholders, as outlined in the project.
The project focuses on two core objectives: a) Provide technical assistance to the labour inspectorate and social partners - The project will enhance compliance with labor laws by strengthening the capacity of the Labour Inspectorate (LI) in alignment with the International Labour Standards (ILS). It will offer comprehensive training, resources, and expert guidance to improve enforcement and oversight. The project will also engage social partners, such as trade unions and employers' associations, to actively promote adherence to labor laws. By reinforcing the principles of International Labour Standards, the project will foster stronger worker protections, ensure fair employment practices, and create a more accountable and transparent labor market.
Upon completion, the Labour Inspectorate will benefit from enhanced expertise, modernized tools, and a data-driven approach, leading to more efficient monitoring and enforcement of labor standards. Businesses will demonstrate improved compliance, ensuring fair wages, safer working conditions, and better worker protections. Social partners will play a more active role in shaping labor policies and encouraging compliance, while heightened public awareness and strengthened institutional cooperation will ensure long-term, effective enforcement. Ultimately, this project will contribute to a fairer, safer, and more productive labor market in Kosovo, driving economic growth and contributing decent work for all.
b) Improving working conditions and boosting productivity in Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - The project will empower SMEs to build safer, more inclusive workplaces, recognizing their crucial role in economic growth and job creation. It will provide expert guidance on enforcing health and safety standards, promoting fair labor practices, and establishing policies that guarantee fair wages and protect workers rights. Additionally, the project will equip SMEs with practical tools and resources to enhance efficiency and competitiveness by prioritizing employee well-being. By aligning business success with worker protection, the initiative will drive sustainable growth, improve working conditions, and strengthen the foundation for a fair and resilient labor market.
